capabilities: Import .eaglepack and zipped .library files singly or in batch
Generate item notes with YAML frontmatter metadata and embedded media
Create gallery index notes grouped by folder for each pack
Mirror Eagle folder trees as real vault folders
Classify items by extension groups and convert Eagle tags to Obsidian tags
extras: Runs entirely in the vault with no Eagle app required and no dependencies (pure-JS ZIP parser); a docs/FORMAT.md documents the reverse-engineered archive layout; unsupported formats like PSD and fonts are imported as linked attachments rather than inline embeds.
problem: Obsidian cannot read Eagle's .eaglepack material-pack archives, so exported design assets and their metadata stay locked outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Import and display Eagle (eagle.cool) EaglePack export files (.eaglepack) inside Obsidian

summary: Eagle import tool that converts .eaglepack exports and zipped Eagle libraries into item notes with embedded media and per-pack gallery index notes.
